task: Standardize Spring Boot API responses and error handling: uniform response wrapper, 201 for POST endpoints, global @ControllerAdvice exception handler, appropriate HTTP status codes, and at least one updated unit test.

key_reasoning.reason: All 4 controllers (ConferenceController, SessionController, SpeakerController, RegistrationController) and all 3 relevant services (ConferenceService, SessionService, RegistrationService) require changes, plus one net-new GlobalExceptionHandler class. This spans every controller-boundary workflow in the application. Red flag applied: affects multiple distinct business workflows (conference, session, speaker, registration).

The @ControllerAdvice handler is net-new to this codebase (no predecessor to model from), though the Spring Boot pattern is well-established. Key risks: (1) security requirement — error responses must never expose stack traces, bumped from M; (2) global IllegalArgumentException mapping could cause unintended 400s from unanticipated sources in RegistrationService; (3) frontend api.js uses data.data || data guards that are a direct coupling point not addressed by the backend-only task scope.

8 modified files (4 controllers, 3 services, 1 existing ConferenceControllerTest) plus 1-2 new files (GlobalExceptionHandler.java, possibly a response wrapper DTO), across 3+ directories (controller/, service/, test/). Falls in the L band (8-10 modified, 2-4 new, 3+ directories).
